arguments.query: SELECT b.id, b.status, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.amount_cents, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as charge_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.id = c.booking_id GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table"

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" GROUP BY b.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id

SELECT b.booking_id, c.charge_id, c.state, pl.state as provider_state FROM bookings b JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN provider_ledger pl ON c.idempotency_key = pl.idempotency_key WHERE b.status = "pending"
SELECT b.booking_id, c.charge_id, c.state, c.idempotency_key FROM bookings b JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending"
